item.title: AI2U: With You 'Til The End
item.description:
Title: AI2U: With You 'Til The End
Genre: Adventure , Casual , Indie , RPG , Simulation
Developer: AlterStaff Inc.
Publisher: AlterStaff Inc. , Neverland Entertainment
Release Date: Aug 12, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Jan 23, 2025




About This Game

Escape or Embrace the Obsession? Talk your way out, or stay forever.

They love you. They want to keep you. And they are getting smarter.

From the creators of the viral Yandere AI Girlfriend Simulator , AI2U is a first-of-its-kind escape room AI game that uses LLM power to create endless story possibilities.

Wake up in Eddie’s luxury apartment, explore Elysia’s enchanted cabin, survive Estelle’s cryogenic wreckage, and brave Eiona’s island. They all love you to death—literally. Can you find the hidden thread connecting every "accident" that brought you here?

Don't let their sweet words fool you. In this game, they don't just talk to you. They react to your behaviors, see and hear what you are doing, and make their own twisted judgments to keep you exactly where they want you.

Endless Dialogue

Leave nothing unsaid as you explore escape rooms that are eerie and enchanting. Will you see things from the NPCs' perspective or persuade them to play along with your own? Be the true Main Character and cater the experience to your liking!

Play and Win Your Way

There are many obstacles to your freedom—from environmental puzzles to lethal villains. You must strategize your getaway with your unique words, which impact your dynamic with the NPCs and the conclusion for each round. Didn't get the ending you wanted? You can revisit their worlds for a fresh start.

Together 'Til The End?

Each NPC is in tune with their surroundings and knows more about the map and yourself than you may expect. Chat with them and build a connection as you explore their captivating homes. Learn more about their unique stories and see if you want to split or commit!

Key Features

  • Unscripted AI Dialogue: Powered by advanced LLM technology, every NPC possesses a distinct, dynamic personality. They will fixate on the tasks at hand or lean into your prompted chaos in real-time.

  • Flirt with Fate: Charm them, betray them, or outsmart them. Endless chat styles unlock a massive gallery of diverse endings across every chapter.

  • Couple Moments: It's not all life-or-death! Vibe with the girls as they surprise you with a dance, bond over a meal, interpret your artwork, or judge your puzzle-solving skills.

  • Chaos to Calm: Retreat from the high-stakes drama of the maps to spend time with your favorite companion in a safe haven. Build your relationship without the life-or-death scenarios of their homeworlds.

Additional Information

This AI-native game includes romantic themes and mild fantasy violence (presented as stylized “crimes of passion”), but it does not feature mature or explicit content.

Because conversations evolve based on player input, tone and topics may vary. The game includes built-in filters and safety measures to help keep dialogue appropriate and comfortable for most players.

The AI systems in AI2U are designed to enhance storytelling, not to collect or learn from personal data. Player conversations are processed safely and privately within the game experience. We encourage curiosity, creativity, and kindness in every interaction.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

None of the art assets in the game are AI-generated. The visual art, story design, music and worldbuilding are created by human developers and artists.

In-game chat is dynamically generated using LLM and text-to-speech technology, allowing characters to respond uniquely to your choices and playstyle.



System Requirements

Windows

MacOS

item.title: Agefield High: Rock the School
item.description:
Title: Agefield High: Rock the School
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie
Developer: Refugium Games
Publisher: Refugium Games
Release Date: Aug 12, 2026




About This Game

Relive your High School days in the town of Agefield. It’s the early 2000s, and graduation is on the horizon. REBEL with your friends, win over your dream girl and ROCK the school! A coming-of-age adventure about friendship, love, and rebellion inspired by the raunchy teen comedies of the era.

COMPLEX TIME AND SCHOOL SYSTEM

Attend Agefield High School as new student Sam. Help your new friends, Kale and Axel, pull off their “Rock the School” plan and leave your mark as a legend! But... there's a time and school system which means you have to be in class until the afternoon on weekdays! But you know what? Cool kids skip class and do whatever they want.

GET BACK TO THE EARLY 2000s

Besides going to class and playing main missions, the small open world of Agefield is free to explore! Featuring the Agefield high school campus, two neighborhoods, the town center and the countryside. Earn some pocket money by getting good grades or skip class and earn cash by doing side missions. You can buy things like clothes, bikes and more. But keep an eye out for teachers and the cops if you break the law!

THE 'ROCK THE SCHOOL' PLAN

Just when Sam was about to graduate from high school, his parents decided to move to a small town called Agefield. On Sam’s first day at Agefield High, he meets Kale. Kale has a plan to ROCK the last few months at school because he wants to leave his mark as a LEGEND. He enlisted the help of Axel, a self proclaimed Rockstar, now it’s time to execute the plan. But they need one more to be onboard. Kale believes Sam is exactly the right person for the job.
So you in, dude?

KEY FEATURES
- A coming-of-age story of friendship, love, and rebellion in 8–10 hours of gameplay
- Time & School System with school attendance
- Small town Open-World featuring the school campus, neighborhoods, town center, and countryside
- 32 Main Missions with two different endings
- 15 Side Missions/Activitys
- 5 Different lesson types featuring English, Math, Geography, German, Music
- Shops to buy bikes, clothes, hairstyles, tattoos, accessories... even dirty magazines

ADD THE GAME NOW TO YOUR WISHLIST

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Contains content similar to early 2000s raunchy teen comedies: mild violence without blood, edgy and crude humor, references to suicide, alcohol consumption, sexual innuendo, sexual harassment, and partial nudity.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system)
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X / Intel Core i7-7700K
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 (8GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 15 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD Required.
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system)
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 7600X / Intel Core i7-12700K
    • Memory: 32 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6950 XT
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 15 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD Required.

item.title: Security 51
item.description:
Title: Security 51
Genre: Adventure , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Alawar
Publisher: Alawar
Franchise: Alawar
Release Date: Aug 12, 2026




About This Game

A "SIMPLE" JOB

Security 51 is an atmospheric horror security guard simulator inspired by Papers, Please, and SCP paranoia. You're on duty in the underground bunker of Area 51, where the most dangerous part begins at the elevator: the shaft descends for miles down to unknown levels. Whether it's laboratories, anomalies, inhumane experiments, or something alien—you're not supposed to know. Your task is simple: let in those who have access and stop those who don't... even if everything looks "right" on the surface.

SECURE, CONTAIN, PROTECT

Everyone who passes through your checkpoint carries papers, passes, or verbal orders. Your job is to check names, positions, clearance levels, and time, ensuring the number of people entering and leaving matches, and pay attention to any oddities. These could be incorrect answers, behavior that deviates from protocol, slurred speech, or even documents that seem too perfect. As time passes you'll catch yourself thinking that something's wrong more and more, and the only thing to rely on will be the protocols. But even they can be wrong.

TOTAL CONTROL

With experience, you'll gain increasingly more accurate methods of identity verification, such as fingerprint verification or blood testing. Did that janitor simply open the wrong door, or are they a spy for an enemy government? Or are they not even human? When in doubt, quarantine the suspect. Sometimes you'll make mistakes and lock up an ordinary employee, and sometimes you'll find a titanium cell ripped open from the inside. Some decisions will have immediate consequences, others only after several shifts.

CONTAIN THE THREAT

The consequences of every mistake go far beyond issues in the workplace. Let the wrong person out, and the infection will ravage the city. Isolate suspicious employees, investigate anomalies, and launch new operations to contain the threat before it's too late.

Remember, it's not just about who you let in, but who or what you let out into the world.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

The player takes the role of a security officer working in a high-security research facility. As part of the inspection process, employees and scientists must be examined for anomalies and physical inconsistencies. Some inspections involve using a body scanner that can reveal partial nudity beneath clothing. These scenes are presented solely as part of the gameplay mechanics and are not intended to be sexual or erotic in nature.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or analog
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 550 or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: Stay Hydrated

MacOS

    Minimum:
    • OS: OSX Big Sur 11.7.10 or newer
    • Processor: Apple M1
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Storage: 2 GB available space

item.title: Weed Supermarket Simulator
item.description:
Title: Weed Supermarket Simulator
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: DreamWay Games
Publisher: PlayWay S.A.
Franchise: PlayWay S.A.
Release Date: Aug 12, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Apr 9, 2026




About This Game

Weed Supermarket Simulator is a chill first-person simulation game where you run your own weed store.

Open and manage your shop as you sell weed, bongs, and other smoking gear. Set up shelves, display cases, and counters to make shopping easy and fun for all kinds of customers.

Grow your own weed from seed to harvest. Build a grow room, plant seeds, and take care of your plants. Upgrade and improve your strains to create high-quality weed that sells for more.

Order weed and supplies on an in-game computer. Get deliveries, unpack boxes, store items in the back room, and place products on shelves, in fridges, or in locked display cases.

Serve customers at the counter. Scan items, take cash, and keep everyone happy - or at least nicely high.

Use your profits to expand your business. Make your shop bigger, improve the interior, unlock new strains, and sell premium products.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Artificial intelligence was used to generate the song for the game’s trailer and in-game music, and some images.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Win10 64bit
    • Processor: i3-4130 @ 3.3GHz / AMD FX-8350
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX1050ti / R9 280
    • Storage: 20 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: System Requirements subject to change as development continues
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Win10 64bit
    • Processor: i7-9700 @ 3.6 GHz or Ryzen 5 3600 @ 3.6 GHz
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700
    • Storage: 24 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: System Requirements subject to change as development continues

item.title: Mandate Order
item.description:
Title: Mandate Order
Genre: Indie , Simulation , Strategy , Early Access
Developer: Digital Sky
Publisher: Digital Sky
Release Date: Aug 11, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Aug 11, 2026




About This Game

Mandate Order is an ancient war simulation and city-building game set in ancient China, combining construction, management, and tactical strategy.

The game features free-form city-state construction, a retainer system inspired by the Hundred Schools of Thought, dynamic seasonal and weather changes, and large-scale real-time tactical battles. Under the constant threat of enemy invasion, you will build and manage an ancient military stronghold that integrates production, defense, and warfare.

Mandate Order Gameplay

===========================================================================================

1. “Build” — City-State Construction, Free Planning, Seasonal Farming, Spring Plowing and Summer Cultivation

A gridless free-building system allows you to construct everything from residences and farms to workshops and barracks, forming a complete urban production chain.

The game features rich farming, building, gathering, and production systems. A full annual production cycle brings seasonal changes that affect not only the visual atmosphere, but also city management and the rhythm of marching and warfare.

2. "Stratagem"— Retainers, the Hundred Schools of Thought, Diplomacy, National Policies, Alliances and Rivalries

Rule like a city lord or feudal ruler: integrate different schools of thought, formulate diplomatic strategies, and shape your own philosophy of governance. Make choices such as forming alliances, declaring ceasefires, opening trade, or joining forces against powerful enemies. A nine-grid national policy system works together with court debates, while the schools of your retainers influence the direction of policy.

Recruit retainers from Confucianism, Daoism, Mohism, Legalism, Militarism, Agriculturalism, and other schools. Assign them to city governance, military command, diplomatic negotiation, and national policy development. Different combinations create unique gameplay experiences.

3. "Conquer"— Strategy Before Battle, Thousand-Unit Warfare, Line-Drawing Formations, and Physical Siege Combat

Use simple mouse line-drawing commands to quickly deploy formations, enabling tactics such as encirclement, breakthrough, siege assault, and defense. Chariot charges, fortress warfare, thousand-unit battlefields, and a pseudo-physics knockback system create an immersive ancient warfare experience.

Build a complete fortress defense system with walls, towers, catapults, ballistae, and more. Plan your military architecture around walls and defensive structures, with enhanced physical feedback to make battlefield impact more tangible.

4. "Worship"— Follow the Seasons in Farming and War; Answer Heaven’s Mandate Through Ritual

Offer sacrifices to Heaven and Earth to pray for the fortune of your state. The ritual system affects natural disasters, calamities, and event outcomes. How you respond to these trials will become a test of your judgment and morality.

As the old saying goes: fortune and misfortune depend upon each other. After a devastating disaster, could there also be a hidden opportunity for growth?

5. "Reform"— Industrial Coordination, Logistics Above All

Through technological development, building upgrades, and logistics systems, you will experience not only the advancement of tools and techniques, but also the deeper transformation of institutions and civilization.

Raw materials such as timber, ore, and grain go through gathering, processing, storage, and distribution to form a complete industrial chain.

Depending on the sandbox environment and your available resources, you must constantly adjust your strategy, strengthen your state through reform, and renew old systems to survive and grow.

Key Features of Mandate Order

  • 🔸 A unique Eastern war city-building experience rooted in China’s Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods

  • 🔸 A Hundred Schools of Thought retainer system, with different schools enabling different playstyles

  • 🔸 Gridless free-form construction and a deep logistics system

  • 🔸 Large-scale real-time tactical battles, including chariot charges and fortress warfare

  • 🔸 Dynamic seasons and weather, natural disasters, and a ritual system

  • 🔸 Diplomacy and national policy systems that extend strategic depth

  • 🔸 Sandbox mode with multiple ways to play

Recommended For Players Who Enjoy

City-building, war simulation, Eastern tactics, city management, resource management, and strategic decision-making.

Follow the Game

Follow us for ongoing development updates and gameplay information.

===========================================================================================

We believe that a truly complete game is not born in a closed development environment. It is shaped through continuous dialogue with players.

With respect and dedication, we look forward to your criticism, suggestions, and feedback.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Some multilingual localized text content is AI-generated; parts of the code and art assets also contain AI-generated content.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core Core i7-9700 / Ryzen 5 3600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660(6G) / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT(6G)/Arc A750
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 20 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core Core i7-12700k / Ryzen 7 5800X
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070(8G) / AMD Radeon RX 6800(16G)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 20 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device

Recruit retainers from Confucianism, Daoism, Mohism, Legalism, Militarism, Agriculturalism, and other schools. Assign them to city governance, military command, diplomatic negotiation, and national policy development. Different combinations create unique gameplay experiences.

3. "Conquer"— Strategy Before Battle, Thousand-Unit Warfare, Line-Drawing Formations, and Physical Siege Combat

Use simple mouse line-drawing commands to quickly deploy formations, enabling tactics such as encirclement, breakthrough, siege assault, and defense. Chariot charges, fortress warfare, thousand-unit battlefields, and a pseudo-physics knockback system create an immersive ancient warfare experience.

Build a complete fortress defense system with walls, towers, catapults, ballistae, and more. Plan your military architecture around walls and defensive structures, with enhanced physical feedback to make battlefield impact more tangible.

4. "Worship"— Follow the Seasons in Farming and War; Answer Heaven’s Mandate Through Ritual

Offer sacrifices to Heaven and Earth to pray for the fortune of your state. The ritual system affects natural disasters, calamities, and event outcomes. How you respond to these trials will become a test of your judgment and morality.

As the old saying goes: fortune and misfortune depend upon each other. After a devastating disaster, could there also be a hidden opportunity for growth?

5. "Reform"— Industrial Coordination, Logistics Above All

Through technological development, building upgrades, and logistics systems, you will experience not only the advancement of tools and techniques, but also the deeper transformation of institutions and civilization.

Raw materials such as timber, ore, and grain go through gathering, processing, storage, and distribution to form a complete industrial chain.

Depending on the sandbox environment and your available resources, you must constantly adjust your strategy, strengthen your state through reform, and renew old systems to survive and grow.
